description: This file defines the class Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Startup.Event, which manages the registration of event handlers during the startup process of the OpenCart catalog module. It loads event data from the database and registers corresponding actions for specific triggers.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A controller class responsible for loading and registering system events during startup in the catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads event configurations from the database and registers each event with its associated action based on predefined triggers.
